rows.name: N1 missing frozen identity file is a HARD STOP (no rollout may start)
N2 a dataset that is not the frozen dev_check is rejected by the identity gate
N3 ONE unequal SHA fails, and an error key fails even when all SHAs are equal (no bool(dict) shortcut)
N4 identical flattened customer sequence with DIFFERENT vehicle attribution is detected
N5 a slot that was started before may NOT be attempted again (one pass, no re-collection) while untouched slots remain eligible
N6 atomic publish (temp+fsync+os.replace) leaves no partial file behind and the manifest SHA matches
N7 a corrupt ledger line is surfaced as corrupt_line instead of being dropped
